extDescription.message: Transliterate selected text between Cyrillic and Latin instantly. Multiple standards, auto direction, fully offline.

cmdOpenConverter.message: Open converter window with the selected text

reverseApproximate.message: Latin → Cyrillic is approximate: some letters are ambiguous.

optStandardDesc.message: Used by the tooltip, the popup and the context menu.

optTooltipDesc.message: A small bubble with the transliteration appears when you select text on any page.

optDelayDesc.message: How long to wait after the selection stops changing.

optIgnoreInputsDesc.message: Do not show the tooltip for selections inside inputs, text areas and editors.

optShortcutDesc.message: Default: Alt+Shift+T opens the converter window. Change it in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

optPrivacy.message: All text is processed locally in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere or stored.
